text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A letter-go-round? What's that
supposed to
be?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, the way it works is, I'm gonna write
a letter
to your family and Grass's family.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then... we'll write a letter to Spe's mother. Is that what a letter-go-round is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Special Week talking with her
friends in the cafeteria, and the sight of
her reminds me of the
last time I spoke
with her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm actually in the middle of
planning out an
important operation!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be fun to write letters
together,
and I'd be able to introduce
both of you to my
mom too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. This does sound very fun. I
wonder what
you've written about me,
Spe.
choice_data_list: (So that's what the strategy was a...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I wrote that you're always really
elegant and that your running form is
beautiful, but somehow
you're still super
fast!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Hehe, your honesty is always so
blindingly
pure.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. What should I write about Sei?
"She's an important friend to me. She's
bright and fun and
brings a calm energy
with her wherever she goes."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't rope me into this. I never said
I'd
participate.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"But it's a real pain when we have to
search for
her when she plays hooky
from training."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know, it's a lot more convenient to
just send
a text. Why go out of your way
to write a letter at
all?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"And recently, she's really been giving
us the slip.
She keeps hiding in all sorts
of places, as if she's a
cat or something."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Because I'm trying not to be found! You think you're the only ones having a tough time?

text_block_list.name: Sky and Grass
text_block_list.text:
"Spe's been sneaking in too many snacks

recently."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-nooo! Don't write that! Mom'll start
sending me
fewer snacks if she finds out!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha! We're just teasing. "That was just
a joke. In
reality, Spe cheers us up a lot
with how energetic
she always is."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Letters just make me more forthcoming
with my
feelings!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Thanks for writing such nice
things about
me, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Don't mention it. Gosh, there's that
gleaming
smile of yours.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Gramps. Thanks for your call and for
watching my scrimmage. I didn't say
this during
our call, but you made me
real happy."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Seiun Sky receives a
letter back
from her grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow. Gramps has some seriously good

handwriting. What's this blotch of ink
over here,
though?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that letter! Did your grandpa send
you a
reply?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that was close! This is
confidential! If you
wanna look, you'll
have to make an official
request first.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Awww... Still, I can tell it's a wonderful
letter just
by looking at your face!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't get anything past a letter connoisseur like you. Fine, you're right! Gramps's letter was tear-jerking and full of warmth!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What's that, Mr. Letter? You want me to
write a
response right away? Well, if you
say so!

text_block_list.name: Letter from Sky's Gr...
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Sky. I should be the one thanking
you for
always bringing a smile to my
face!"

text_block_list.name: Letter from Sky's Gr...
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you run fills me up with joy
and energy! All you have to do is
continue working hard and
being who
you are, all right?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad the letter made you so
happy, Sei.
Seems like my letter
operation was a success.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Guess it's my turn now to read the
letter I
got back from my mom. ♪

text_block_list.name: Letter from Spe's Mom
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Spe. A 'letter-go-round' sounds
like a really
fun idea. I'm happy to learn
that you have so
many good friends."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Spe's Mom
text_block_list.text:
"Their kindness and personalities came
through loud and clear. Cherish those
friendships. Spe, my dear. I wish you a
life of happiness, forever and
always."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Mom! Me and my dear
friends and
rivals are all doing our very
best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Mom! Me and my dear
friends and
rivals are all doing our very
best!

text_block_list.name: Letter from Spe's Mom
text_block_list.text:
"P.S. Since you apparently have been
snacking so
much, I'll be cutting back on
the amount of
carrots I send you."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!
